user_authorization: Production image tools authorized; no images, image links, binary or Base64 in main chat. One materially changed NW canonical-conditioned production edit; no retries.
corrective_reason: Previous NW walk v02 HOLD is preserved and not referenced. New source canonical key v01 explicitly verifies correct rear-upper-left back/helmet/toes and original right-hand ownership; author all six phases from that new heading basis.
phase_contract: 0 HIGH: wings lifted at both real shoulder-root joints, feather fans high and open; gentle upper-left travel lean, one leg softly forward-bent and the other trailing bent.
1 MID DOWN: both wing roots rotate through a middle downstroke with articulated feather fans; hips and shoulders counterbalance, leading knee tucks and trailing knee releases.
2 LOW: deepest coherent downstroke, both complete fan tips low beside the body, shoulder roots and elbows visibly articulated; airborne legs trail and exchange soft bends.
3 LOWER RETURN: distinct folding return after low stroke, wing fans slightly tucked backward with different silhouette from phase2; opposite knee bends, cape lags behind.
4 MID RISE: wings rise through midstroke and fan outward, shoulder and torso settle; airborne legs pass toward original arrangement while cape follows with delay.
5 HIGH RETURN: wings reach a second high recovery with visibly different sweep/elbow/fan angles from phase0; gentle upper-left forward lean continues, leg pose distinct and naturally loops to phase0.
